title: The Wrong Way to Use Healing Magic
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Usato is accidentally summoned to a fantasy kingdom alongside two student-council leaders chosen as heroes. He turns out to have rare healing magic, and Captain Rose of the Rescue Team puts him through brutal physical training so he can run onto battlefields and heal the wounded. The comedy turns into war drama as the Demon Lord's army attacks, and later into diplomatic travel.
life_message: Saving lives is as heroic as fighting, and hard discipline can make a weak person strong enough to protect others.
